Provides near-term cash, but proceeds are before placement agent fees and estimated offering expenses.
The exercise brings in proceeds while increasing the outstanding share count.
Creates potential future dilution; the warrants are immediately exercisable and expire in three years.
Closing expected on or about Nov. 6, 2026
